why: No major reviewer or authority answers this: the only famous name (PCMag) came back as a Cloudflare error and is a general NAS guide anyway. Two sources answer the exact under-$300 2.5GbE question, but one explicitly disclaims lab testing and the other is an affiliate roundup; the rest are spec databases, Amazon price tables, general 2-bay or whole-home guides whose picks exceed $300, a DIY build log, a paywalled anecdote, and two empty pages. A focused page with cart-checked prices on the DXP2800, F2-424, AS3302T v2 and TS-233, a tested-code column, and a direct pick would stand out.
